subject: Re: MAP — POC environment access & peering windows
messages:
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@careflow.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: CareFlow IT <it@careflow.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC MAP: access, keys, network

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at CareFlow is excited to move to a short POC. To get our MAP started, we need a clear checklist and dates for the items below so we can align our infra team:

- Org setup: will you provision a customer org or do we create and invite users?
- API keys: do you support scoped API keys for POC (read-only vs admin)? Expected ETA?
- IP allowlist: we need the public IP list that Redwood will allow (we will add on our side). Also need the outbound IPs for your hosted connectors if any.
- VPC peering: sample request template + available peering windows (we're on AWS us-east-1).

If you can send a short mutual action plan with owners and target dates, I can get our procurement and IT into a weekly cadence. Attached a one-page summary from our side.

Appreciate it —
Rajiv
Director of Integrations
CareFlow.ai
Attachments: CareFlow_POC_brief.pdf (summary)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@careflow.ai>
Cc: CareFlow IT <it@careflow.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP: access, keys, network

Hi Rajiv —

Great to hear — we can absolutely put a concise MAP together. Below is a pragmatic plan that covers the items you listed. I've proposed owners on our side; please confirm who will own the corresponding tasks at CareFlow.

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Week 0 (today — 3 business days):
  * Redwood: create customer org placeholder and invite primary admin (owner: Mina Haddad)
  * CareFlow: confirm primary admin and list of test accounts (owner: Rajiv Patel)
- Week 1 (3–7 business days):
  * Redwood: issue scoped API key (env: staging) + README for key rotation and scopes. (owner: Neha Kapoor)
  * CareFlow: complete vendor security questionnaire answers for staging access.
- Week 2 (7–14 business days):
  * Redwood: provide IP allowlist and peering template; open support ticket for peering window (owner: Hannah Schmitt)
  * CareFlow: submit VPC peering request and schedule window with infra team.
- Week 3 (14–21 business days):
  * Joint smoke tests, latency checks, and performance baseline. Sign-off for pilot to begin.

Key notes:
- For the POC we recommend scoped staging keys (no production data) and a short TTL on keys (we can rotate after initial tests).
- IP allowlist will include our staging egress + control plane addresses; peer will be one-way at first for metrics.
- We'll share an AWS peering request template (minimal fields needed) and propose peering windows early morning US East to avoid business traffic.

I've attached a quick MAP spreadsheet (CareFlow_MAP_v1.xlsx) that maps dates, owners and acceptance criteria. If that looks good, I'll loop in Neha and Hannah to implement the entitlements and network side.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Manager, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
attachments: CareFlow_MAP_v1.xlsx

Subject: Fwd: POC MAP: access, keys, network — ownership and ask

Folks — forwarding CareFlow's request and the MAP I proposed. Quick asks and assignments so we can hit Week 0/1. I'm the program owner for this POC (point for escalation).

Action items (Redwood owners):
- Neha: please provision a customer org placeholder in sandbox and prepare a scoped staging API key (scopes: generation, embeddings, readonly admin flag). Include key TTL of 7 days and a rotation doc. Target: 3 business days.
- Hannah: prepare the VPC peering template and the list of staging egress IPs/control plane IPs. Draft the peering ticket summary we will send to CareFlow (include CIDR expectations and route table note). Target: 7 business days.
- Mina: I'll send the MAP spreadsheet and confirm the initial invite for Rajiv's admin account.

Risks/notes:
- If CareFlow's procurement requires SOC2 artifact review before keys, that could push to Week 2 — flag early.
- For peering we need org account IDs from CareFlow; ask Rajiv to confirm AWS account numbers.

Please ack with a one-line ETA (I want to consolidate and reply to Rajiv before EOD).

Thanks —
Mina

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP spreadsheet; that format works for us. Confirming ownership on our side:
- CareFlow owner (admin): Rajiv Patel (me)
- Infra owner for peering: Priya Menon (priya.menon@careflow.ai)

Answers and scheduling:
- We'll accept a Redwood-provisioned customer org for the POC. Please invite my account (rajiv@careflow.ai) as admin.
- API keys: scoped staging key is fine. We need an RN (reference number) for the key issuance so procurement can track; please put that in the issuance email.
- IPs/account numbers: attached vpc_peering_request.txt with our aws account numbers and a proposed peering CIDR. Proposed peering window: Mon 2027-08-02 06:00–08:00 US‑East (we can move earlier if needed).
- Procurement: they requested SOC2 Type II evidence for vendor onboarding; I've started the questionnaire and will share the partial answers by Monday. This will not block the early key issuance unless they require production access.

Next steps: please send the invite + staging key reference and the peering template. We'll submit the AWS peering request end of day Monday to hit the Aug 2 window.

Cheers,
Rajiv
